interpretation: Engineering comparison of v5 broad search and experimental v6 dual-stage search. Same depth values describe different selective trees; four opening seeds are four clusters, not 64 independent games. No statistical strength certification. Existing v5 remains default if any predeclared adoption condition fails.

storage.eventRows: Zero-based row index is replay event index; every row is a canonical action event. move: [side, move, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, promote]; drop: [side, drop, pieceKind, toX, toY]. Coordinates are zero-based. Other replay metadata is retained. Local input snapshots are identified by raw SHA256, not uploaded.
storage.critical: 40 expanded cases from five tactical families; full 88 are 11 families x four orientations x both restriction settings.
